tools.name: BusyBox
tools.prompt: Common shell commands. Invoke an explicit applet, for example busybox sh -c ...; do not assume Unix commands are on PATH.
tools.description: 提供常用文件管理、文本处理和 shell 命令。

tools.name: curl
tools.prompt: HTTP requests and downloads. Retain HTTPS certificate verification.
tools.description: 通过 HTTP、HTTPS 等协议下载文件或发送网络请求。

tools.name: jq
tools.description: 查看、筛选和转换 JSON 数据。

tools.name: OpenSSH
tools.prompt: SSH remote access. scp and sftp are in the same directory as this ssh executable; pass this ssh path with their -S option when needed.
tools.description: 通过 SSH 连接远程设备，并使用 SCP、SFTP 传输文件。

tools.name: aria2
tools.prompt: Batch and large downloads. Use an explicit destination and HTTPS verification. On Android the adjacent cacert.pem can be supplied with --ca-certificate.
tools.description: 支持多连接下载、断点续传、磁力链接和 BitTorrent 下载。

tools.name: ripgrep
tools.prompt: Search code and text with rg -n or --json; rg --files lists files. Default ignore rules apply; use --hidden or --no-ignore only when needed.
tools.description: 快速搜索文件内容，支持正则表达式和忽略规则。

tools.name: 7-Zip
tools.prompt: List (l), test (t), create (a) and extract (x) archives. Choose an explicit output directory.
tools.description: 创建、查看和解压多种格式的压缩文件。

tools.name: Python
tools.prompt: Run Python scripts, -c or -m. Do not assume pip, third-party modules or development headers are installed.
tools.description: 运行 Python 脚本，处理数据并自动完成重复任务。

tools.name: Git
tools.prompt: Git command-line version control: status, diff, log, branches, commit, clone, fetch and push. Prefer non-interactive commands and per-command -c settings. SSH transport requires an SSH client. GUI, Perl/SVN/email adapters are excluded.
tools.description: 管理源代码版本，查看修改记录并与远程仓库同步。

tools.name: SQLite CLI
tools.prompt: SQLite 3.54.1 command-line shell. Inspect schema and query databases; use -readonly for existing databases unless changes are requested. Supports JSON/CSV output, JSON SQL functions, FTS5 and RTree.
tools.description: 查询和维护 SQLite 数据库，执行 SQL 并导入、导出数据。

tools.name: Poppler
tools.prompt: Poppler PDF utilities: pdftotext extracts text, pdfinfo reports metadata, pdftoppm/pdftocairo render pages, pdfimages extracts images, pdffonts lists fonts, pdfseparate/pdfunite split/merge PDFs. Scanned pages need a separate OCR tool.
tools.description: 提取 PDF 中的文字和图片，并将 PDF 页面转换为图片。

tools.name: FFmpeg
tools.prompt: FFmpeg and ffprobe for audio/video conversion, extraction, metadata and filters. Common H.264/H.265, VP8/VP9, AV1, AAC, MP3, Opus, subtitles, drawtext and HTTPS support. Use ffprobe before processing; choose explicit output paths. No GUI player or GPU shader toolchain.
tools.description: 转换、剪辑和合并音视频，提取音轨或视频画面。

tools.name: ImageMagick
tools.prompt: ImageMagick 7.1.2-34 Q16. Use magick for image conversion, resize, crop, composition and batch processing; magick identify/compare/montage expose companion operations. PNG, JPEG, WebP and TIFF are supported. PDF reading may require an external delegate; prefer Poppler for PDF extraction/rendering.
tools.description: 批量转换和编辑图片，调整尺寸、裁剪、合成及添加文字。
